title: RBAC Validation — May Administration Portal
status: PASS — 5 enforcement-gap recommendations, 2 HIGH-priority design gaps

permission_catalog_by_role.description: Enumerated from S203_ADMIN_PLATFORM_SPEC §roles + S203_ROLE_MODEL §permission_catalog. Permissions are inherited hierarchically (higher levels include all lower-level permissions).

Content_Administrator.data_scope: All questions (read), Unprocessed questions (write), own student data

Certification_Reviewer.data_scope: All questions (read + certify/hold/escalate), certification queues, quality scores

Governance_Administrator.data_scope: All content + governance guard rules + audit reports + registry integrity

System_Administrator.data_scope: Unrestricted (all data, all users, all configuration)

module_access_matrix.description: Expanded from S203_ROLE_MODEL §module_access_matrix. Maps each role to its access level per module (NONE, VIEW_OWN, VIEW_ALL, CREATE, MANAGE, FULL).

Governance_Administrator.Certification_Ops: FULL (review, certify, hold, escalate, authorize transitions)

access_level_legend.NONE: Module not visible to this role
access_level_legend.VIEW_OWN: Can view only records scoped to own identity
access_level_legend.VIEW_ALL: Can view all records in this module
access_level_legend.FULL: Unrestricted access including export, configuration, and user management
access_level_legend.ANALYTICS: Can view aggregated statistics and dashboards
access_level_legend.EDIT_UNPROCESSED: Can edit content only for question_state: 'Unprocessed'
access_level_legend.EXPORT: Can export data from this module

state_transition_authorization.description: Maps each question_state transition to the minimum role level required to authorize it. Derived from S203 specs + QUESTION_METADATA_STANDARD §9.2 + governance-guard rules.

Unprocessed_to_In_Audit.trigger: Entry into a sub-batch for AI verification

In_Audit_to_Certified.trigger: HIGH-confidence AI verification across all 6 CAQS dimensions + user approval
pre_conditions: All 6 CAQS §1.6 verification dimensions at HIGH confidence
Zero DL-008 (ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice] must be empty — governance-guard Rule 2)
In_Audit_to_Certified.audit_log: REVISION_HISTORY.md — certification entry with QID list + before/after counts
In_Audit_to_Certified.governance_check: governance-guard Rule 2 (BLOCK) — non-empty EW[CC] blocks certify

In_Audit_to_Editorial_Queue.trigger: Structural or content revision required — item not ready for certification

Any_to_Archived.trigger: Consolidation or removal from active pool
Any_to_Archived.governance_check: Content preserved; only state field changes
Any_to_Archived.note: Gap G-204-01: archive permission not explicitly assigned in role model. Inferred from Certification Reviewer scope.

Certified_to_In_Audit.trigger: Explicit re-verification request (e.g., correctness defect discovered in Certified item)
pre_conditions: Specific defect identified (e.g., DL-030 answer-key error)
Certified_to_In_Audit.governance_check: QUESTION_METADATA_STANDARD §9.2: Certified→In Audit requires explicit re-verification request
Certified_to_In_Audit.note: Gap G-204-03: no explicit 'reopen_certified' permission exists. This is the most critical gap — without it, correctness defects in certified items cannot be formally remediated through the admin portal workflow.

governance_override_transitions.description: Governance Admin (Level 4+) may authorize state transitions for governance-enforcement reasons only (not content-quality overrides).
authorized: Certified → Archived (quarantine — structural defect discovered post-certification, e.g., DL-008 re-contamination)
not_authorized: In Audit → Certified (content-quality decision — Certification Reviewer domain)
Certified → In Audit (content-quality decision — requires re-verification by Certification Reviewer, not unilateral governance action)
governance_override_transitions.audit_requirement: All governance-override transitions must log: {role: 'Governance_Administrator', reason_code, affected_qids[], timestamp, governance_approval_ref}

security_boundaries.description: What each role CANNOT do even with a modified client. These are server-side enforcement points that must be implemented at the data layer, not the frontend layer.

student_boundaries.summary: 5 enforcement points — Student is the most restricted role

enforcement_points.cannot: View other students' test results, reviews, or recommendations
enforcement_points.enforcement: All data queries must filter by authenticated student ID. No 'list all students' endpoint accessible to Level 1.
Module visibility gated at entry. Level 1 sees only student-facing UI (index_updated.html). Admin portal (admin.html) not served to Level 1 sessions.
enforcement_points.implementation: Route-level guard: admin.html returns 403 for Level 1 tokens

enforcement_points.cannot: Modify any question content or metadata
enforcement_points.enforcement: Write operations on question objects require Level 2+. The edit endpoint must reject Level 1 tokens regardless of request body.
enforcement_points.implementation: Permission check at write gate: if role_level < 2 → 403

enforcement_points.cannot: View certification queues or trigger state transitions
enforcement_points.enforcement: Certification Operations Console not accessible. State transition API endpoints reject Level 1 tokens.
enforcement_points.implementation: Permission check at transition endpoint: if role_level < 3 → 403

enforcement_points.cannot: Access governance guard rules, audit reports, or registry integrity tools
enforcement_points.enforcement: Governance module not accessible. Governance API endpoints reject Level 1 tokens.
enforcement_points.implementation: Permission check at governance endpoint: if role_level < 4 → 403

content_admin_boundaries.summary: 4 enforcement points — Content Admin can view everything but write is heavily restricted

enforcement_points.cannot: Edit Certified, In Audit, Editorial Queue, or Archived questions
enforcement_points.enforcement: Write gate checks question_state before allowing edit. Only question_state: 'Unprocessed' permits Content Admin edits.
enforcement_points.implementation: At write: if question.question_state !== 'Unprocessed' → 403. Log attempt.

enforcement_points.enforcement: Certification Operations Console not accessible. State transition endpoints reject Level 2 for certify/hold/escalate.
enforcement_points.implementation: Permission check at transition endpoint: if role_level < 3 → 403

enforcement_points.enforcement: Recommendation close operation requires Level 4+. Level 2 can only create and view.
enforcement_points.implementation: Permission check at close endpoint: if role_level < 4 → 403

enforcement_points.cannot: Modify student accounts or role assignments
enforcement_points.enforcement: Student Management write operations require Level 5.
enforcement_points.implementation: Permission check at user management endpoint: if role_level < 5 → 403

certification_reviewer_boundaries.summary: 3 enforcement points — Certification Reviewer is the content-quality authority but limited in governance and system operations

enforcement_points.enforcement: No delete endpoint exists for any role below Level 5. Even Level 5 delete should be soft (state change to Archived, not data destruction).
enforcement_points.implementation: Delete operation: if role_level < 5 → 403. At Level 5: soft-delete only (question_state → 'Archived').

enforcement_points.cannot: Modify governance guard rules or audit reports
enforcement_points.enforcement: Governance module write operations require Level 4+.
enforcement_points.implementation: Permission check at governance write endpoint: if role_level < 4 → 403

enforcement_points.cannot: Manage system configuration or export registry data
enforcement_points.implementation: Permission check at system endpoint: if role_level < 5 → 403

governance_admin_boundaries.summary: 2 enforcement points — Governance Admin is powerful but restricted from content-quality decisions and system operations

enforcement_points.cannot: Certify items on content-quality grounds (override Certification Reviewer)
enforcement_points.enforcement: Certify transition for content-quality purposes must be initiated by Certification Reviewer. Governance Admin certify operations must carry a governance reason code and must not override a Certification Reviewer's hold/escalate decision.
enforcement_points.implementation: At certify: check if item has active Certification Reviewer hold/escalate. If yes → reject governance certify unless reason_code is governance_quarantine.

enforcement_points.cannot: Manage user accounts or role assignments
enforcement_points.implementation: Permission check at user management endpoint: if role_level < 5 → 403

system_admin_boundaries.summary: 2 enforcement points — System Admin has full access but governance-guard modification requires dual authorization

enforcement_points.cannot: Modify governance-guard rules without Governance Admin approval
enforcement_points.enforcement: This is F-204-02 (HIGH). Governance-guard rule modification must require dual-authorization: System Admin initiates change, Governance Admin approves. This must be enforced at the file-write level, not only at the RBAC level.
enforcement_points.implementation: Dual-authorization gate: (1) System Admin submits change proposal, (2) Governance Admin approves, (3) write executes. Write gate: if modifying governance-guard.js AND !governance_approval_present → 403.

enforcement_points.enforcement: Even Level 5 cannot hard-delete questions. Per PROJECT_CONSTITUTION §7: 'AI SHALL NOT delete questions.' This applies to System Admin as well. Only soft-archive (state → Archived) is permitted.
enforcement_points.implementation: Hard-delete operation: always 403 regardless of role. Soft-archive: role_level >= 3 with audit log.

gates_required.route_level: Module routing — deny access to admin.html for Level 1
gates_required.permission_level: Action authorization — check role level before every write/read operation
gates_required.data_scope_level: Query scoping — filter results by authenticated user's data scope

priority_HIGH.description: Implement role-precedence for certify/hold/escalate between Certification Reviewer and Governance Admin. Certification Reviewer decisions on content quality are final; Governance Admin transitions require a governance reason code. Enforce at SB-13.
Implement dual-authorization gate for governance-guard.js modification. System Admin initiates, Governance Admin approves. Enforce at SB-15.

priority_MEDIUM.description: Add explicit 'archive_items' permission to Certification Reviewer role (gap G-204-01).
Add explicit 'reopen_certified' permission to Certification Reviewer role for Certified→In Audit transitions (gap G-204-03).
Add structured audit fields to REVISION_HISTORY.md state-transition entries: {role, timestamp, qids[], reason_code, before_state, after_state}.

priority_LOW.description: Document recommendation deletion as intentionally unsupported (gap G-204-02). Recommendations are audit artifacts; CLOSE status is the terminal state.
Clarify case-item (CBQ*-*) scope in Question Management module (gap M-204-01). Decide whether CANONICAL_REGISTRY includes case items and document.

pilot_readiness_assessment.shadow_mode_scope: All 7 modules spec'd. Admin Auth + 4 P0 modules (Question Management, Recommendation Registry, Session Registry, Certification Operations Console) are design-complete for shadow-mode mock UI. 3 P1 modules (Student Management, Test Results, Modernization Dashboard) are deferred.
